title: The Spirit Stone
author: Katharine Kerr
note: conf=0.96; The ISBN 9780007371167 matches the Kobo ebook edition titled "The Spirit Stone (The Silver Wyrm, Book 2)" by Katharine Kerr (HarperVoyager). It is the second book of the "Silver Wyrm" act (the tight sub-series) within the larger Deverry cycle, where it is book thirteen overall. Some UK print editions were marketed as "Book Five of the Dragon Mage," but the ebook edition matching this ISBN uses the Silver Wyrm designation.
